title: chore(totals): rename a local variable in total
body:
## Summary
Rename the local variable t to running_total in total() in src/totals.py.

## Rationale
The one-letter name is hard to read; a descriptive name makes the accumulation easier to follow.

## Testing
Validation plan: compare total() results for sample inputs before and after the rename; no new test is added.

## Limitations
Only the variable in total() is renamed; other names in the module are unchanged.

files.patch:
diff --git a/src/totals.py b/src/totals.py
--- a/src/totals.py
+++ b/src/totals.py
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 def total(prices):
     # Add up the prices.
-    t = 0
+    running_total = 0
     for price in prices:
-        t += price
-    return t
+        running_total += price
+    return running_total
